title: FCF and funding

summary.definition: FCF는 영업활동에서 번 현금에서 필요한 투자를 뺀 현금 흐름이고 funding은 부족한 자금을 조달하는 구조다.
summary.mechanism: 마진·운전자본·CAPEX·리스·차입·증자가 성장 속도와 재무 위험을 결정한다.
summary.example: 매출이 커져도 CAPEX와 매출채권이 더 빨리 늘면 외부 자금이 필요할 수 있다.
summary.counterScenario: FCF 정의와 조정 항목은 기업·기간·회계정책에 따라 다르므로 원문을 확인해야 한다.
summary.visualization: 영업 현금 → 운전자본·CAPEX → FCF → 자금 조달·상환

formalModelOrRationale.text: 마진·운전자본·CAPEX·리스·차입·증자가 성장 속도와 재무 위험을 결정한다.

inputs: 매출이 커져도 CAPEX와 매출채권이 더 빨리 늘면 외부 자금이 필요할 수 있다.

article.tradingApplication: 성장 기업의 음의 FCF가 투자와 구조적 손실 중 무엇인지 어떻게 구분할 것인가?
article.invalidation: FCF 정의와 조정 항목은 기업·기간·회계정책에 따라 다르므로 원문을 확인해야 한다.

researchEvidence.statement: The Federal Reserve describes a stable financial system as one that continues to provide financing through banks, lenders, and markets without becoming excessively vulnerable to shocks; leverage, liquidity, interconnectedness, and maturity transformation can amplify stress.
researchEvidence.scope: Credit creation, banking, liquidity, and financial-stability mechanisms
researchEvidence.invalidation: This is a mechanism and monitoring framework, not a diagnosis of current stability, a recession forecast, or evidence that every credit expansion is unsafe.

researchEvidence.statement: A filed 2025 Form 10-K example separates property-and-equipment capital expenditures in investing cash flow from depreciation recognized after assets are placed in service; capacity investment, accounting expense, and cash generation therefore need separate time and statement-line analysis.
researchEvidence.scope: CAPEX, depreciation, utilization, unit economics, and free-cash-flow interpretation
researchEvidence.invalidation: This is one issuer's filing example and not a universal accounting policy or current forecast; company disclosures, useful lives, capitalization policy, and reporting standards must be checked separately.

researchEvidence.statement: At its August 2026 Investor Day, Sandisk described NBM contracts with weighted-average duration above four years and stated coverage targets of 50 percent of revenue in FY2027 and about two-thirds in FY2028. It also presented FY2028–FY2030 non-GAAP targets of mid-to-high-teens average revenue growth, about 80 percent gross margin, about 75 percent operating margin and about 50 percent adjusted free-cash-flow margin.
researchEvidence.scope: Dated company contract and financial targets
researchEvidence.invalidation: These are forward-looking company claims using non-GAAP measures and assumptions. Contract modifications, customer concentration, pricing floors, mix, taxes, working capital, capital intensity and reconciliations must be verified against future filings and results.
